purpose: decide whether the official Binance funding-interval change creates a distinct exact-match post-change history test for rank 43 without prematurely sampling funding or prices
exact_match_rule: Binance base asset CXMT must equal the Polymarket base_asset CXMT literally; leveraged ETF, related-company, translated-name, or substring matches are prohibited.

economic_test_boundary.role_split: oldest 6 training, next 3 validation, newest 3 test with orientation frozen before history access
economic_test_boundary.premature_action: make zero funding, price, book, fee, account, credential, order, fund, or transaction requests before the earliest history capture

decision_rules: If any required official term or the exact retained Polymarket match fails, reject without market data.
If all source and match gates pass, admit only a future post-change history test; do not claim that a wider cap or shorter interval implies favorable realized funding.

At the future test, freeze one fixed receiving-leg orientation before history access and reject unless training, validation, and test are each positive after the fixed execution and two-leg capital hurdles.
Books, fees, account evidence, or execution testing require a separately frozen later gate after a persistent history survivor.
Never place or simulate an order under this contract.
